# Lonelog {.hero-title}

[A Standard Notation for Solo RPG Session Logging]{.hero-sub}

[v1.7.0]{.version-pill}

A lightweight shorthand language designed to separate mechanics from fiction,
stay compact at the table, and scale from quick one-shots to sprawling campaigns.

[Read the Docs](docs/en.md){.btn .btn-dark .me-1}
[Download on itch.io](https://zeruhur.itch.io/lonelog){.btn .btn-outline-dark .me-1}
[GitHub](https://github.com/lonelog/lonelog){.btn .btn-link}

![](assets/banner.png){.hero-banner fig-alt="The five core Lonelog symbols: @ ? d: -> =>"}
:::

## Quick Start {.section-label}

``` {.lonelog filename="session-log.md"}
### S1 *Dark alley, midnight*
@  Sneak past the guard
d: Stealth 4 vs TN 5 -> Fail
=> I kick a bottle. Guard turns!
?  Does he see me clearly?
   -> No, but...
=> He's suspicious, starts walking toward the noise
```

## Core Philosophy {.section-label}

::: {.grid .philosophy}
::: {.g-col-12 .g-col-md-4 .pillar}
[@]{.pillar-symbol}

**Format-agnostic**

Works the same in digital Markdown code blocks and in paper notebooks.
:::

::: {.g-col-12 .g-col-md-4 .pillar}
[d:]{.pillar-symbol}

**Toolbox, not a rulebook**

Fully modular. Use the five core symbols, or layer in clocks, threads and NPC tags as you need them.
:::

::: {.g-col-12 .g-col-md-4 .pillar}
[→]{.pillar-symbol}

**Built for scannability**

Standard tokens let tools, plugins and human readers parse logs at a glance.
:::
:::
